svg.title: A pulse between a brain-like network and a machine-like network
svg.desc: On the left, a network of points joined by curved, branching links, labelled brain. On the right, a regular lattice of points joined by straight links, labelled machine. Two lines join them. A pulse has crossed from the brain to the machine and is spreading through it, and a pulse has crossed from the machine to the brain and is spreading through it.
